Chapter 1
Sunny stared at the rain-soaked street. Sunny moved slowly toward the gate.

Chapter 2
"Hold the line," Nephis said. Sunny replied and Nephis nodded.

Chapter 3
Cassie walked beside Sunny in silence. Cassie warned him about the ambush.

Chapter 4
Rain rushed into the room. "We have to leave," Rain said while Cassie watched.
